Indian sailor's body returned from Venezuela with organs missing

The body of an Indian sailor, who died in Venezuela, was returned to his family in a severely decomposed state. The family reported that the sailor's brain, lungs, and heart were missing from the body, and that there were 22 cuts on his body. An autopsy was conducted after the body's arrival.
